global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma nestled atop noodles. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden surface under warm, natural light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a blue floral pattern on white, with a brown speckled rim and glossy surface.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and greens in a shallow, circular pool.
regions.spoon: A dark, glossy spoon with a curved, slightly worn surface and visible food residue on its bowl.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, glistening slices with marbled fat, irregular shape, and slightly curled edges.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear translucent, pale brown, with curled, segmented shapes and glossy, slightly wrinkled surfaces.
